landing.heroSubtitle: CODA analyzes your real financial data, diagnoses your situation, calculates your credit score and recommends the best financial products in Chile. Free for you.
landing.noPaymentRequired: Free forever. No credit card required.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Diagnosis, scoring, comparison and recommendation. All based on your real financial data.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: From your data to your financial plan in minutes
landing.step1Desc: Upload your bank statement and debt certificate. Your data is processed securely and privately.
landing.step2Desc: CODA calculates your dual credit score, analyzes your financial behavior and detects concrete opportunities.
landing.step3Desc: Receive prioritized recommendations with compared products based on your real profile. Contract directly from CODA.
landing.ctaTitle: Start improving your financial health today
landing.ctaSubtitle: Create your free account and receive your first financial diagnosis in minutes.
landing.feature1Desc: Two complementary engines: traditional (credit history, 0-850) and transactional (financial behavior, 0-100). Calculated with your real data.
landing.feature2Desc: Automated analysis of income, expenses, debts, liquidity and behavior patterns. No technical knowledge needed.
landing.feature3Desc: Compare real offers across consumer loans, mortgages, cards, deposits, mutual funds, credit lines and portability.
landing.feature4Desc: Recommendations prioritized by your net benefit. CODA ranks by value for you, not by commission.
landing.feature5Desc: Permanent tracking of your financial health and the market. Alerts when real savings opportunities arise.
landing.feature6Desc: We never share your information without your explicit consent. Designed to comply with CMF regulations and Data Protection Law.
landing.whyFreeDesc: We don't charge users. Our model is based on commissions with financial institutions.
landing.whyRealDataDesc: Your diagnosis and recommendations are calculated with your financial documents, not generic estimates.
landing.whyNeutralDesc: Recommendations are ranked by your net benefit, not by what institutions pay us.
landing.whyRegulatedDesc: Designed from day one to operate under Chile's Fintec Law framework and CMF supervision.
landing.categoriesSubtitle: CODA analyzes and compares real offers from Chile's financial market
landing.catTarjetasDesc: Find the ideal card for your profile
landing.catCreditosDesc: The best rates and conditions available
landing.catFondosDesc: Alternatives based on your risk profile
landing.catPortabilidadDesc: Save by switching to the right product
